title: Fix MIC-selector short-address vector byte layout
description: Correctness review found both selector_0_with_short_addr and selector_1_with_short_addr in test/vectors/mic_length_selector.json encode input_hex as 08 LLSEC 02 0012 34ab cd68, while their oracle says dst_addr_hex=abcd and the likely intended fields are seqnum=0x1234, dst=abcd, payload=68. Focused python/tests/test_vectors.py failures prove LichenFrame decodes dst=34ab. Correct both wire literals (and ensure the test explicitly preserves the intended sequence/payload fields) so selector 0/1 address-mode cases are real equivalent oracles. Run focused tests and 3x review after the fix.
